title.narrative: Strengthening Press Freedom Centres in Ukraine

description.narrative:
The purpose of the contract with RSF is to contribute to fostering access to independent and reliable media coverage of the war by providing and promoting a safer environment for journalists and media professionals. The project has three main components:

1.Protection, assistance, and strengthening of the capacities of journalists and media professionals covering the war in Ukraine:

· providing necessary equipment such as power generators, communication equipment, and protective gear;

·      training programs, including Hostile Environment Awareness Training (HEAT) and psychological support sessions;

2.Fighting impunity of crimes against journalists, media professionals, and media in Ukraine:

·      daily monitoring of press freedom violations and reporting of abuses;

·      advocacy and strategic litigation to hold perpetrators accountable;

·      raising awareness on the importance of accountability and seeking to set important legal precedents.

3.Informing and mobilising public opinion on press freedom abuses:

·      production and broadcasting of a documentary film based on the investigations carried out during the project period;

·      defining and implementing specific communication campaigns to raise public awareness;

organising debate events related to the projection of the documentary film to raise awareness on the press freedom situation in the context of the war
